# SECTION 1: TOP-LEVEL DISPATCHER
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

tv_check_all_milestones_effect = {
	tv_check_conquest_milestones_effect = yes
	tv_check_prosperity_milestones_effect = yes
	tv_check_trade_milestones_effect = yes
	tv_check_diplomatic_milestones_effect = yes
	tv_check_cultural_milestones_effect = yes
	tv_check_science_milestones_effect = yes
}

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 2: PER-PATH MILESTONE CHECKERS
# Guards via var:tv_*_milestone < N prevent re-triggering after grant.
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ── Conquest Victory ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
tv_check_conquest_milestones_effect = {
	# Initialise on first call (guards against missing variable)
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_conquest_milestone } }
		set_variable = { name = tv_conquest_milestone value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:tv_conquest_milestone < 1
			tv_conquest_milestone_1 = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_conquest_milestone value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = tv.conquest.1
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:tv_conquest_milestone < 2
			tv_conquest_milestone_2 = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_conquest_milestone value = 2 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = tv.conquest.2
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:tv_conquest_milestone < 3
			tv_conquest_milestone_3 = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_conquest_milestone value = 3 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = tv.conquest.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:tv_conquest_milestone < 4
			tv_conquest_milestone_4 = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_conquest_milestone value = 4 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = tv.conquest.4
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:tv_conquest_milestone < 5
			tv_conquest_milestone_5 = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_conquest_milestone value = 5 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = tv.conquest.5
	}
}

# SECTION 3: PROGRESS PERCENTAGE UPDATER
# Stores tv_*_progress_pct in [0.0, 1.0] for each path (used by GUI bars).
# Called monthly for players, yearly for AI — must be cheap to evaluate.
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

tv_update_all_progress_pct_effect = {
	# ── Conquest Victory ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
	# TODO: compute 0.0-1.0 progress fraction for conquest path
	# Formula: tv_conquest_progress_pct = raw_metric / v2_threshold
	# V2 threshold hint: ~1600 owned locations
	# Pattern:
	#   set_variable = { name = tv_conquest_progress_pct value = <raw_metric_accessor> }
	#   change_variable = { name = tv_conquest_progress_pct divide = <v2_threshold_literal> }
	#   if = { limit = { var:tv_conquest_progress_pct > 1 } set_variable = { name = tv_conquest_progress_pct value = 1 } }

	# ── Prosperity Victory ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
	# TODO: compute 0.0-1.0 progress fraction for prosperity path
	# Formula: tv_prosperity_progress_pct = raw_metric / v2_threshold
	# V2 threshold hint: Composite development score threshold 5 (very high)
	# Pattern:
	#   set_variable = { name = tv_prosperity_progress_pct value = <raw_metric_accessor> }
	#   change_variable = { name = tv_prosperity_progress_pct divide = <v2_threshold_literal> }
	#   if = { limit = { var:tv_prosperity_progress_pct > 1 } set_variable = { name = tv_prosperity_progress_pct value = 1 } }

	# ── Trade Victory ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
	# TODO: compute 0.0-1.0 progress fraction for trade path
	# Formula: tv_trade_progress_pct = raw_metric / v2_threshold
	# V2 threshold hint: Trade hegemon threshold
	# Pattern:
	#   set_variable = { name = tv_trade_progress_pct value = <raw_metric_accessor> }
	#   change_variable = { name = tv_trade_progress_pct divide = <v2_threshold_literal> }
	#   if = { limit = { var:tv_trade_progress_pct > 1 } set_variable = { name = tv_trade_progress_pct value = 1 } }

	# ── Diplomatic Victory ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
	# TODO: compute 0.0-1.0 progress fraction for diplomatic path
	# Formula: tv_diplomatic_progress_pct = raw_metric / v2_threshold
	# V2 threshold hint: tv_diplomatic_victory_points >= 580
	# Pattern:
	#   set_variable = { name = tv_diplomatic_progress_pct value = <raw_metric_accessor> }
	#   change_variable = { name = tv_diplomatic_progress_pct divide = <v2_threshold_literal> }
	#   if = { limit = { var:tv_diplomatic_progress_pct > 1 } set_variable = { name = tv_diplomatic_progress_pct value = 1 } }

	# ── Cultural Victory ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
	# TODO: compute 0.0-1.0 progress fraction for cultural path
	# Formula: tv_cultural_progress_pct = raw_metric / v2_threshold
	# V2 threshold hint: tv_cultural_influence_points >= 580
	# Pattern:
	#   set_variable = { name = tv_cultural_progress_pct value = <raw_metric_accessor> }
	#   change_variable = { name = tv_cultural_progress_pct divide = <v2_threshold_literal> }
	#   if = { limit = { var:tv_cultural_progress_pct > 1 } set_variable = { name = tv_cultural_progress_pct value = 1 } }

	# ── Scientific Victory ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
	# TODO: compute 0.0-1.0 progress fraction for science path

	# V2 threshold hint: tv_science_score — Age 5 (steam/industrial) threshold
